prOriginal.nota: Found via upstream commit history of src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py (843d7c7192, Alexander Tarasov). PR head branch fix/oauth-validate-github-integration-user has the same 5 commits ending at bb75657f; git diff bb75657f..843d7c71 on the 3 touched files is empty, so merged code equals the benchmark head.

github-oauth-security-enhancement-sentry.reason: The legacy OAuthLoginView was removed in #113338 (2026-04-20), but the logic moved to the API pipeline: _build_github_oauth_url still sends state=pipeline.signature and OAuthLoginApiStep.handle_post compares validated_data['state'] != pipeline.signature. pipeline/base.py still computes signature as md5 of the pipeline view class names, a constant per provider.

Today exchange_github_oauth calls safe_urlopen before the try that only guards safe_urlread/parse, and client.get_user_info() is unguarded; handle_post only catches GitHubPipelineError and organization_pipeline.py api_advance has no generic handler. Transport or HTTP errors still escape as 500 instead of the error result.

validate_github_installation today still returns installation_id on Integration.DoesNotExist without comparing github_authenticated_user to any installer; a comment now documents this as an accepted race ('we proceed without the sender validation'). Behaviour unchanged.

validate_github_installation today still indexes integration.metadata['sender']['login'] unconditionally (when no chosen_installation), while build_integration still sets sender only if state.get('sender'). The KeyError path remains.

Scanning every upstream revision of tests/sentry/integrations/github/test_integration.py since the merge, test_installation_not_found with the wrong state ddd023d8... is present unchanged until #113338 'Remove legacy pipeline views' (2026-04-20), which deleted it together with the legacy views (-609 lines in the test file). The test was removed with the flow, not fixed.
